system_texts: Ownership and accountability of decisions are unclear due to delegation phrases with no explicit owner.
Not everybody is ready to start the meeting, as one participant says 'Not really' when asked if everyone is ready.

gold_texts: Computer/display problems disrupted preparation and presentation; the screen-size problem was adjusted and the presentation was brought back online during the meeting.
The industrial designer received key instructions too late to incorporate them fully, leaving the presentation and design incomplete.

The industrial and user interface designers initially disputed their responsibilities. They settled on industrial design defining functions and user interface design arranging the layout and menu, with coordination between them.
